assertions.description: The auto popover surface exists: popover attribute IDL and :popover-open matching are available (the surface the dismissal change applies to).
HTMLDialogElement exposes the closedby IDL attribute — the opt-in that gives dialogs light dismiss.
Popovers dispatch ToggleEvent with oldState/newState — the observable used to record dismissals.
A right-click (contextmenu) outside an open auto popover must NOT light-dismiss it in Chrome 153+ (whatwg/html #11536; pre-153 builds dismiss, which this assertion correctly fails on).
assertions.test: Open an auto popover, right-click outside it with a real pointer, and verify the popover remains open. Verified failing (popover dismissed) on Chromium 141 via trusted CDP input 2026-08-16 — the honest pre-153 result.

assertions.description: A touch pan that scrolls content outside an open auto popover must NOT light-dismiss it in Chrome 153+.
assertions.test: On a touch device (or real touch input), open the popover and pan-scroll outside content; the popover must remain open on 153+. Synthetic CDP touch did not map to pointer input in the headless harness, so this contract requires real-device verification.

assertions.description: A completed plain click outside an open auto popover still light-dismisses it under both old and new semantics.
assertions.test: Open the popover and click outside with a real pointer; it must close. Verified passing on Chromium 141 via trusted CDP input 2026-08-16.
